description: Never Ending Interview band card (16:9 and 9:16): 1–2 lines as written (names in capitals, band or "x NAME" below) with RGB split on black and a still of the interview in the image box, fading into black on the text side. Revealed and left by chevron wipes (band_card as extension input of a wipe). Glitch-in over 3 frames, 1–2.5 s, opaque H.264.

parameters.lines: 1–2 lines of at most 24 characters, as written: ["MYLES KENNEDY", "alter bridge"] or ["EVIL JARED", "x KROGI"]
parameters.image: Optional still { sourceId | extensionId, in, crop? } (in = source seconds; crop with the output aspect like a timeline clip, otherwise cover)
